svg.title: A-200 Section A–A
svg.text: LEVEL through the core · 1:50 @ A1 · METRES
Masonry wall cut by section — 200 mm
Internal stud or block partition, 120 mm
Single leaf door, swing shown to opening side
Glazed opening — arched head where noted
Element above the cut plane (pergola, slab
1. Section looking west, cut on the line marked A–A on the
floor plans: through the south glazing, the lift shaft,
the protected lobby, the stair and the room at the north
2. Both ends of block A are glazed: the north boundary is
open, so the cut passes through a north window at every
level. The light court that stood here in P3 has been
built over, giving back 7.3 m² a floor.
3. The lift shaft is built full height with removable infill
slabs at each level, shown dashed, so a lift can be
installed later without cutting structure. Pit and overrun
are indicative and to be confirmed against the chosen
4. Flat slab on the column grid, 300 mm structural zone,
giving 3.00 m clear at every level and 3.30 m floor to
5. The stair is enclosed in the middle of block A and has no
external wall, so it is smoke-vented at its head by a 1.2
m² automatic opening vent through the roof slab, shown
open. The single-stair strategy is the client's decision
and still needs the authority's agreement.
6. Foundations are shown indicatively only and are subject to
a ground investigation and the engineer's design.
Preliminary design issue — not for construction.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
P2 2026-09-24 east windows, taller floors, garden on A-100
P3 2026-09-29 four storeys, apartments, straight north boundary
P4 2026-09-29 north and east opened up, light court removed
